name: Facet Roundstick
description: Both rods circle in matched orbits at either hip, the user's field of qi steadying each turn.

name: Dowelwrath
description: The outer edge of one orbit is allowed to slice through the opponent's guard at the wrist.

name: Staveglare
description: The user glides sideways along the line between the two orbits, never crossing either rod's path.

name: Numbing Gripstick
description: Two orbits close on a blade between them and pin it flat against the user's forearm.

name: Indomitable Capstick
description: The matched orbits turn together as one wheel that deflects each stroke along its curved face.

name: Lacerating Stickend
description: Where the orbits cross, the lower rod lashes out and cracks the opponent's leading knee.

name: Stavewrath
description: The two orbits tighten from opposite sides like shears and cut through the guard to the ribs.

name: Doctrine Octastick
description: The user's orbits interleave in a ring of moving rods that hems the opponent into a small space.

name: Streaking Neckwrap
description: Both orbits close as the user crosses the gap in an instant and lands a double strike behind the guard.

name: Facet Swingstick
description: Rods folded back along the arms like closed wings, the user waits poised to open them.

name: Ironstave
description: Opening both rods like wings, the user brings the nearer one down on the opponent's shoulder.

name: Mightrod
description: A short hop on each wing-beat of the rods changes the user's angle without losing balance.

name: Murkstave
description: The rods fold shut across the line of a thrust and turn it aside with a hinge snap.

name: Rumble Sidespin
description: A claw-like clip of the cord catches the weapon hand and spoils the opponent's grip.

name: Rodscourge
description: Both hinges open and the rods rise together to strike under the opponent's chin and elbow.

name: Strangling Cascade
description: The winged rods fold over a limb and pull it tight toward the user's chest.

name: Gust Hardstick
description: Spinning on one foot, the user sweeps a blow off with one rod and rakes with the other.

name: Facet Tiedend
description: Both hinges drive down together in a plunge that passes through an overhead guard onto the shoulders.

name: Slagstave
description: The rods swing wide at full extension like beating pinions and strike everyone within the reach.

name: Glint Shoulderroll
description: On the wing-beat the user vanishes from the front and reappears at the opponent's flank with a crossing strike.

name: Indomitable Chainjoint
description: The user stands calm as still water in a basin, rods hanging so their ripple can be felt.

name: Iron Fliparound
description: The rod flows round a curve like a river bend and lands on the opponent's unguarded side.

name: Torrent Swingstick
description: The user flows with the pressure of an advance, drifting aside as water slips past a stone.

name: Gust Capstick
description: The cord turns in a small eddy that catches a stroke and swirls it harmlessly aside.

name: Octastick Reckoning
description: Rod after rod pours over the opponent's guard like a spillway, pressing it lower with every pass.

name: Ponderous Fliparound
description: The cord coils about a weapon in a spiralling eddy and draws it toward the user.

name: Gripstick Mettle
description: A low sweep of the cord drags the opponent's ankle like an undertow, upsetting their stance.

name: Dismantling Backspin
description: The rods surge outward in a wave-like sweep that carries over everyone standing within reach.

name: Equipoise Stickend
description: The cord fills the space around the opponent in ever-tighter loops until they can only stand still.

name: Impervious Chainjoint
description: Letting the opponent's blow fill the cord like a basin, the user releases the full force back along the same line.

name: Iron Cordjoint
description: Guard and attack are held in separate rods at once, each ready to change places on a breath.

name: Stavescourge
description: Both rods rise and fall in turn, each landing a downward cleave on the same guarding arm.

name: Might Shoulderroll
description: The user slides from one track to the other, exchanging position with the swinging rod.

name: Murk Cordjoint
description: The two rods cross as a single block and push a heavy stroke outward off the user's body.

name: Toxinclack
description: A tap of the cord on the opponent's sleeve reads their intent and shifts their balance a fraction.

name: Tempered Roundstick
description: A flurry from first one track and then the other keeps the opponent guessing which rod will land.

name: Numbing Cascade
description: One track presses the opponent's arm downward and the other locks the elbow in place.

name: Hoarfrost Capstick
description: The tracks roll over each other before the chest, shielding the body as a continuous turning plane.

name: Chimeclack
description: The cord snags the opponent's hip and a sharp turn of the tracks spins them off their feet.

name: Iron Neckwrap
description: Both tracks drive forward in the same line and punch through a shield or double guard.

name: Downpour Backspin
description: The tracks weave a ring around the user and strike every opponent that has closed in.

name: Hourrod
description: A chain of guard, bind and strike is run through both rods without a pause between them.

name: Maiming Charter Hardstick
description: Twin rod tips land on two meridian points of the opponent's arm at once, locking its qi flow.

name: Thorn Swingstick
description: The user's rods rest crossed over the belt, with one court on either side of the hinge.

name: Hardstick Ruin
description: A cut from the left court sweeps through the right court to land on the opponent's far shoulder.

name: Roundstick Whirlpool
description: The user paces the courts' boundary in short, even steps, always keeping both rods to hand.

name: Gustrod
description: An orbit crossed from one court to the other meets a blow and shunts it beyond both.

name: Chime Chainjoint
description: A sharp ringing snap of the cord on the opponent's blade jars its edge from true.

name: Granite Stickend
description: The courts' orbits cross and recross, pressing the opponent between them and giving no rest.

name: Gyve Gripstick
description: A loop from each court encircles an opponent's wrists in a single crossing pull.

name: Gust Tiedend
description: The inner court's rod turns the blow and the outer court's rod lashes from behind it.

name: Eviscerating Neckwrap
description: The user changes courts mid-swing so the lash arrives from the opposite side from the expected line.

name: Ponderous Cordjoint
description: The crossed orbits advance as one weight, pushing a whole line of opponents back across the ground.

name: Hour Tiedend
description: A strike from each court in turn, left, right, inner and outer, comes down in one unbroken chain.

name: Ghosting Shoulderroll Vortex
description: Crossing both courts in an instant, the user reappears inside the opponent's reach and breaks their attack.

name: Rodmettle
description: On a raised foot or ledge the user holds both rods high and ready to fall.

name: Iron Backspin
description: The rod plummets steeply onto the opponent's crown or shoulder with the user's full weight behind it.

name: Torrent Fliparound
description: The user runs down a slope in long glides, rods held back for the final plunge.

name: Hoarfrost Gripstick
description: The cord falls in front of the user like a curtain of motion, breaking up a shower of small projectiles.

name: Gyveclack
description: Dropping from above, the hooked rod catches an upraised wrist and drags it downward.

name: Sanguine Sidespin
description: Struck on the ground, the rod bounds up again and cuts at the opponent's face as it rises.

name: Cascade Havoc
description: A rod released from the greatest height of the swing cleaves through the guard and the shoulder behind it.

name: Ponderous Backspin
description: The user plunges with both rods spread, pinning the opponent's two arms against the ground.

name: Corroding Hardstick
description: One final dive of the rod drives through a defence and cannot be turned once begun.

name: Dowelnerve
description: The cord is carried low and slack as on a long march, its rods ready in a heartbeat.

name: Iron Tiedend
description: With nothing to snag the cord, the rod swings a full, wide arc and lands hard on the opponent's arm.

name: Mightdowel
description: On stony or tussock ground the user keeps balance by striding with short, rolling steps.

name: Murk Chainjoint
description: Even with rain on the cord and wind in the face, the rod meets the blow squarely and deflects it.

name: Hoarfrost Sidespin
description: The cord is cast over the opponent's weapon from the longest reach and drawn back with it.

name: Shade Capstick
description: With the wind on the plateau at his back, the user presses forward under continual swings.

name: Rumble Neckwrap
description: The cord snaps across a slope at the opponent's heels and trips them downhill.

name: Silt Swingstick
description: The user sweeps a vast arc along the plateau's edge, driving all within it toward the drop.

name: Deeddowel
description: A cord set low across the approach waits until the opponent steps over it, then snaps up and binds the legs.

name: Immobilizing Cordjoint
description: A cord drawn across the opponent's wrist and neck presses the points where qi flows and locks the circulation.

name: Roundstick Mettle
description: The user stands with one hand on the cord in the posture of a sworn oath, rods hanging steady.

name: Rumblewhirr
description: A rod lifted on a rising gust cuts up from below the opponent's guard.

name: Granite Cascade
description: Stepping with a draft rising up the slope, the user covers a pace in the time of a breath.

name: Unrelenting Roundstick
description: The rod is held where it was sworn to hold and meets the blow with unmoving weight.

name: Toxin Shoulderroll
description: A snap of the cord into an updraft jerks the opponent's hand upward and ruins their aim.

name: Blaze Stickend
description: The orbit climbs steadily with the wind and comes down in a lash from above the head.

name: Ponderous Octastick
description: Orbit after sworn orbit presses the opponent back, none ever falling short of its mark.

name: Dowelspine
description: The rod hooks beneath a hilt on a rising draft and lifts the weapon from the hand.

name: Gyvewhirr
description: The cord spirals upward round the opponent in the wind and tightens each turn.

name: Berserk Tiedend
description: The rods are swept in a huge rising circle that strikes everyone within the gale's reach.

name: Whirrscourge
description: The rod rises on the gale to its height and falls on the oath's bearing, piercing the guard.

name: Headlong Sidespin
description: Carried on the gale in an instant, the user arrives within the opponent's reach and strikes before they react.

name: Facet Cordjoint
description: With nothing for cover, the user fixes a distant mark and holds the rods in line with it.

name: Blistering Cascade
description: The rod follows the line to the chosen mark and lands exactly on it.

name: Ghosting Hardstick
description: The user paces forward along the line of the bearing, never drifting right or left.

name: Rumble Fliparound
description: The cord is stretched across the bearing line to stop an opponent crossing it.

name: Murk Capstick
description: The rod deflects along the bearing and returns along it in a single motion.

name: Shade Stickend
description: Swing after swing falls on the same line, making the opponent give ground one pace at a time.

name: Gyvestave
description: The cord is cast along the bearing and tethers the opponent to the point where it lands.

name: Neckwrap Wrath
description: The rod's fall is aimed at a single mark and drives through whatever stands before it.

name: Wrathful Rumble Swingstick
description: The rod and the user both cross the open ground along one bearing and strike before the opponent senses it.

name: Octastick Nerve
description: Cord and rods trail a little in the breeze while the user keeps both hands close and alert.

name: Lacerating Octastick
description: The cord is cast on the wind and the rod cuts across from an unexpected side.

name: Rodblink
description: The user moves with the wind's direction, letting it carry each stride a little farther.

name: Murk Gripstick
description: The cast rod is recalled at once and parries the stroke on its return.

name: Strangling Fliparound
description: A quick tap from the cord's tip tricks the opponent's guard into the wrong place.

name: Blazerod
description: The orbit rides the wind outward and the rod lashes from beyond the opponent's guard.

name: Mayhem Sidespin
description: The cast cord winds round a weapon and a hard recall hauls it out of the hand.

name: Fastening Capstick
description: The cord is thrown in a spiral that winds about the opponent and tightens as the user pulls.

name: Dismantling Shoulderroll
description: The cord is swung in a vast sworn circle that strikes all who stand upon the same ground.

name: Novastave
description: Cords cast across the ground on the wind lie in wait to catch any foot that treads upon them.

name: Blinding Backspin
description: The cast rod is recalled so fast on the wind that it seems to strike from two places at once.

name: Whirrdurance
description: Both rods are set to one sworn bearing, held in front of the body like an oath held in two hands.

name: Rumble Cordjoint
description: Each rod falls along the same line, the second following the first onto the opponent's guard.

name: Meteoric Stickend
description: The user pivots about the bearing's fixed point and stays aligned with the target.

name: Roddurance
description: Both rods meet a stroke on the bearing and hold it off without a step.

name: Toxin Chainjoint
description: A snap of the cord into the wind makes a crack that unsettles an opponent's careful timing.

name: Wrathful Tiedend
description: The rods lash in alternation along the bearing, each one drawing the opponent's guard to the wrong side.

name: Suffocating Shoulderroll
description: With the bearing taken, the cord falls cleanly over a wrist and locks it fast.

name: Ponderous Hardstick
description: Both rods advance along one sworn line and force the opponent to retreat the whole way.

name: Octastick Valor
description: The rods turn in a ring about the sworn bearing and shield against missiles from the front.

name: Lacerating Cascade
description: Both rods fall along the bearing as one bar and crash through the guard.

name: Downpour Gripstick
description: The user spins both rods round the bearing in a wide circle that strikes all within the cord's length.

name: Doctrine Chainjoint
description: A bind, a parry and a double strike are worked through along the bearing in one sworn sequence.

name: Deedrod
description: Two taps of the rod tips at the shoulder and wrist lock the opponent's arm and its qi.

name: Aegis Roundstick
description: Standing in the open with nothing behind, the user lets the rods circle freely at both sides.

name: Titanic Swingstick
description: With nothing near to hinder it, the rod orbits through its full circle and cuts across the opponent's arm.

name: Rodflash
description: The user paces in long, loose strides across open ground, rods circling in rhythm with each step.

name: Chimedowel
description: Facing the wind, the user braces the cord across the forearm and sends a stroke wide.

name: Rodwrath
description: Wide orbits fill the space about the user, pressing the opponent toward the open ground behind.

name: Gyve Backspin
description: A free orbit loops its cord over the opponent's hand and tightens as the user turns.

name: Flintlike Swingstick
description: The orbit slips out of a bind and turns the same stroke into a counter against its maker.

name: Mayhem Fliparound
description: Without anything near to stop them, both rods sweep a boundless ring around the user.

name: Shoulderroll Devastation
description: The orbit climbs to its height and falls steeply, piercing the opponent's raised guard.

name: Thundering Sidespin
description: The user vanishes from one side of the orbit and arrives on the other with a strike already landing.
